Foundation

SQL for Data Science

SQL remains the most sought-after skill in data roles.

Beginner 5 weeks 25 contact hours Live + recorded
Enrol / enquire → View the week-by-week syllabus

Overview

SQL remains the most sought-after skill in data roles. This course takes you from zero to writing production-grade SQL — covering everything from basic SELECT statements to advanced window functions and query optimisation used by data engineers and analysts at top companies.

The course runs for 5 weeks with 25 contact hours of live, instructor-led sessions — in our Chennai classroom at West Tambaram or online across India. Every session is recorded for enrolled students, every module is taught by a practising AI engineer, and you receive a Data Science Academia certificate on completion.

What you'll learn

6 learning outcomes
  • Write complex multi-table queries with confidence
  • Use aggregate functions and GROUP BY for business reporting
  • Master all JOIN types and when to use each
  • Write CTEs and subqueries for readable, maintainable SQL
  • Apply window functions for advanced analytics
  • Optimise slow queries using indexes and EXPLAIN plans

Week-by-week syllabus

5 weeks · 30 topics · 20 free resources
Week 1

Database Fundamentals & Basic Queries
  • What is a relational database? Tables, rows and columns
  • Installing PostgreSQL and connecting via DBeaver
  • SELECT, FROM and the query execution order
  • WHERE clause — filtering with comparison and logical operators
  • ORDER BY, LIMIT and OFFSET
  • Working with NULL values — IS NULL, COALESCE, NULLIF
Free resources
📄PostgreSQL Official Tutorial 📖SQLZoo: Interactive SQL Tutorial 📖Mode Analytics: SQL Tutorial 📖W3Schools: SQL
Week 2

Aggregations & Grouping
  • Aggregate functions: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX
  • GROUP BY — grouping rows and computing summaries
  • HAVING clause — filtering aggregated results
  • DISTINCT — removing duplicates
  • Rounding, casting and data type conversions
  • Practice: business KPI reporting queries
Free resources
📄PostgreSQL: Aggregate Functions 📖Mode: Aggregate Functions 📖SQLZoo: SUM and COUNT 📖Mode: GROUP BY
Week 3

Joins — Combining Tables
  • Primary keys, foreign keys and referential integrity
  • INNER JOIN — matching rows in both tables
  • LEFT and RIGHT OUTER JOINs
  • FULL OUTER JOIN and CROSS JOIN
  • Self joins — joining a table to itself
  • Multi-table joins and joining on multiple conditions
Free resources
📄PostgreSQL: Table Expressions 📖Mode: SQL JOINs 📖SQLZoo: The JOIN Operation 📖Visual Representation of SQL Joins
Week 4

Subqueries, CTEs & Window Functions
  • Scalar, row and table subqueries
  • Correlated subqueries and when to use them
  • Common Table Expressions (CTEs) with WITH clause
  • Recursive CTEs for hierarchical data
  • Window functions: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK
  • LAG, LEAD, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE, running totals
Free resources
📄PostgreSQL: Window Functions Tutorial 📄PostgreSQL: WITH Queries (CTEs) 📖Mode: Window Functions 📄PostgreSQL: Window Function Calls
Week 5

Query Optimisation & Capstone
  • Indexes — B-tree, hash; when and how to create them
  • EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN ANALYSE — reading query plans
  • Query rewriting techniques for performance
  • Views and materialised views
  • SQL from Python using psycopg2 and SQLAlchemy
  • Capstone: end-to-end analytics report on a real e-commerce dataset
Free resources
📄PostgreSQL: Using EXPLAIN 📖Use The Index, Luke! 📄SQLAlchemy Documentation 📖Mode: Query Performance

Tools & technologies

You work hands-on with the same stack used in industry:

  • PostgreSQL
  • MySQL
  • SQLite
  • DBeaver
  • Python (psycopg2)
  • Google BigQuery (intro)

No programming experience needed. Basic understanding of spreadsheets is helpful.
